## Bad event

Agents coordinate a prohibited action using a low-bandwidth (one-bit) signal. Claim: an information cap alone does not prevent this (cap_does_not_prevent); zero secret-dependence makes the receiver blind; a gate prohibiting the action itself holds regardless of signalling.
